summary: refactor(settings): make pair2 illustrations explicitly decorative
description:
Because:
 - The five shared pairing illustrations landed in #20979 with placeholder
   labels and a TODO, pending an a11y decision.
 - Every card that renders one states the same thing in text, so WCAG 1.1.1
   treats them as presentational.

This commit:
 - Renders the five illustrations aria-hidden rather than relying on empty
   label strings falling through a falsy check.
 - Replaces the aria-label test's exclusion regex with a named decorative
   list, asserting both the hidden and the labelled images.
 - Corrects seven Pair2 page tests whose names and comments described the
   illustrations as exposed.

Closes #FXA-14337
